title: 第三百四十七章 脱身之法第三百四十六章 山穷水尽
lines: 第两百四十七章：脱身之法
就在叶重苦想脱身之法时，距离叶重等人不远处，十几条背后有破风青狼虚影闪烁的人影，便是在叶重等人的眼前急速掠过，让得叶重眼眸之中陡然精光一闪。
随即只见叶重突然跳了起来，随即鼓起全部元气放声大叫起来道：“我是巡风司严苛，严大人的至交好友！我们在长安被人打劫图财害命！救命啊，救命啊！严苛，你不出来救人，我操你十八代祖宗！”。
此刻天降大雨，体内的元气在大雨中威势凭空增加了三倍。叶重的声音盖过了雷霆声，翻滚着传出去了二十几里地。而朱易则是被叶重的大叫声，吓得浑身一个哆嗦，好大的两颗白眼瞪了过去。
既然要用这一招，刚才还这么努力的逃命干什么？
在叶重的呼喊声落下之后，十几个从附近经过的巡风司所属的人，便是立刻朝这边纵跃而来。伴随着轻轻的狼啸声，充满木属性灵气的狂风当面袭来，身穿黑色软甲，背负利剑，和当日的严苛一个打扮的精悍男子，已经将叶重四人团团围住。
叶重的声音实在是太大了一些，造成的动静也太大了一点。
远处不断有一道道碧青色光芒冲天飞起，近百个巡天鹰卫带着刺耳的鸟啼声，朝这边急速飞来。远远近近的狼啸声更是绵绵不绝于耳，长安好像变成了一个野狼窝，到处都是狼啸声，到处都是一条条青色的身影，带着狂风朝这边疾驰而来。
不过是一盏茶的时间，近百巡天鹰卫就聚集在高空急速盘旋，碧青色的怪鸟虚影荡起狂风，吹拂得雨滴宛如子弹一样‘飕飕’的向下激射。超过三百名融合了破风青狼兽魂的巡风司魂武也赶到了现场，四周墙头上，站满了巡风司的人。
随之是十几声粗犷的狮吼声远远传来，十几个身穿重甲，周身火光熊熊，背后有一头高从四丈到八丈不等的烈焰雄狮兽魂，生得高大魁梧壮硕异常的大汉带着大群士卒赶了过来。
所有人都目不转睛的盯着叶重，目光很是古怪。
最后赶来的十几个壮汉中，背后的烈焰雄狮兽魂高达八丈，周身散发出滚滚热流，雨点一靠近他就化为水汽飞散开，身体被浓浓的白色水汽包裹住的壮汉大步走上前来，仗着比叶重高了一尺半的身高，居高临下的俯瞰着叶重，上下打量了他好一阵子。
“严苛那小子的‘至交好友’？嘿，操他十八代那个的‘至交好友’？严苛这小子，还真有福气！”
叶重咧咧嘴，干涩的笑了笑。这大汉身上散发出的气息实在是太吓人了一些，雄厚、宏大、狂暴无比，这是一个真正的武皇巅峰的高手。其身上的威势，比之药王药尘都是强上几筹。
干笑了几声，叶重朝这看起来大概也就三十几岁的大汉拱手道：“不知将军尊姓大名？”。
大汉‘嘿嘿’怪笑了起来，重重的一巴掌拍在了叶重肩膀上：“姓严，严苛的严。我叫严回，大汉巡风司西风卫大巡狩，是严苛他亲爹。你刚才，说是要操他十八代那个祖宗？”。
大汉巡风司，分东南西北中五大风卫，分别对应大汉朝东南西北四个方向的诸多诸侯国和大汉朝本土的一应事务。大巡狩，就是一个风卫的最高执行长官，有先斩后奏之权，甚至很多时候，先斩不奏，也没人会追究其中的详细。
此刻，朱易额头上一阵冷汗渗了出来。巡风司西风卫，专责监探大汉朝西方诸多诸侯国，宋国，就正是大汉朝西方诸侯国之一。从某种意义上而言，西风卫是宋国诸多世家豪族头顶悬着的一柄利刀。
虽然大汉朝从不轻易插手诸侯国的内政事务，但是堂堂西风卫的大巡狩，真要插手宋国的事情，谁又敢说个不字？谁又会说个不字？如果严回说要整治宋国，还不知道有多少人会跳着脚的搬起石头往宋国的头顶上砸呢。
干咳了一声，朱易上前两步，朝严回行礼道：“大巡狩，朱易在此有礼了。”。
严回嘿嘿笑了几声，朝朱易摆了摆手，大笑道：“少废话，刚才这小子说的话，这么多人，全听到了。而我严回在长安，也是有根基有头脸的人，被这小子当面辱骂，以后叫我严回怎么见人？”。
狠狠的瞪了若无其事的叶重一眼，严回吧嗒了一下嘴，望着朱易冷笑道：“你是什么人？今晚的事情到底是怎么回事？嘿，城防黑甲墙都倒了三里多长的一截，谁和你有这么大的血仇要杀你？”。
伸出手，严回就朝朱易的脖子抓了过去，接着大笑道：“哎，和你们这些小娃娃废话什么？抓回去一通严刑拷打，什么事情不知道？孩儿们，抓人了，准备家伙给他们消受消受！”。
叶重拦在了朱易面前，伸手一掌朝严回的腕脉劈了过去，叶重接着则是淡然的道：“大巡狩何必动怒？小子无礼，也是被逼无奈，若是不这么叫一声，小子们怕是性命都保不住了。”。
看叶重居然敢对自己动手，严回眼里火光一闪，突然大笑起来。他收掌变拳，一拳朝叶重掌心轰下，而后大笑道：“好，来，来，来，你能打赢我，今晚上的事情我给你扛下了！”。
拳掌相碰，叶重只觉当面一座大山压了下来，巨力震得他立足不稳，闷哼一声就朝后退去。炽热的拳劲轰入了叶重手臂经脉，却正好和刚才那妖鬼侵入他经脉中的阴寒之气中和，水火相克，阴气热气迅速中和，叶重经脉中元气一阵波动，刚刚还有点僵硬不灵便的手臂顿时恢复了正常。
严回却是身形一震，他一拳打在叶重掌心，虽然击退了叶重，可是他也被叶重掌心诡异的旋涡状气劲扭得身体一歪，八成拳劲都落了空。他身体一抖，自己轰到空处的拳劲拉着他的身体就朝斜刺里踉跄着冲出了十几步，一拳把路边的墙壁轰出了老大一个窟窿。
“好拳劲！”，叶重大叫了一声。
“好掌力！”，严回惊异不定的收回拳头，狠狠的盯着叶重上下打量了起来，“小小年纪居然是武王境界。唔？刚才那小子自称朱易？莫非是朱易？你小子，难不成就是他的门客叶重？”。
朱易一喜，他急忙应道：“大巡狩也听过朱易的名字？”。
“呸！”，严回一口浓痰吐在了地上，他重重的拍了拍脑门，大喝道，“严苛那小子说起过你们。你们不在宋国等着封赏，来长安干什么？”。
一声轻轻的狼啸声传来，严苛带着几个人从远处急速冲了过来。青影闪过，严苛纵身落在了街道上。在看了叶重一眼之后，则是十分欣喜的道：“果然是你们！叶重，你这张嘴可真，真是让人难得消受！”。
摇摇头，严苛望向了严回禀告道：“大巡狩，朱易可能是左国正的后人，他这次来，应该是去国宗府认定血脉传承，归于宗籍，继承左国正的爵位和左国正官职的。”。
朝朱易笑了笑，严苛接着沉声道：“刚刚收到的消息，国宗大人刘戈公，正和荣阳夫人赶来这里。”。

Chapter 247: How to escape
Just when Ye Zhong was trying to think of a way to escape, not far away from Ye Zhong and others, a dozen or so figures with the shadow of the Blue Wolf behind them flashed past the eyes of Ye Zhong and others, causing a sudden flash of light in Ye Zhong's eyes.
Then Ye Zhong suddenly jumped up, and then he mustered up all his strength and shouted loudly: "I am Yan Yan, Lord Yan of the Patrol Division! We were robbed for money and killed in Chang'an! Help, help! Yan Yan, if you don't come out to save people, I'll fuck your eighteen generations of ancestors!"
At this moment, it was raining heavily, and the power of the vitality in his body increased three times out of thin air in the heavy rain. Ye Zhong's voice drowned out the thunder and rolled over twenty miles. Zhu Yi, on the other hand, was so frightened by Ye Zhong's shout that he trembled all over and stared at him with big white eyes.
Since he was going to use this move, why were he trying so hard to escape just now?
After Ye Zhong's shouts fell, a dozen people from the patrol department who passed by nearby immediately jumped towards this side. Accompanied by the gentle howl of wolves, a strong wind full of wood-attribute spiritual energy hit in front of him. A strong man dressed in black soft armor, carrying a sharp sword, and the harshness of the day had already surrounded Ye Zhong and four others.
Ye Zhong's voice was really too loud, and the movement he caused was also too loud.
In the distance, streaks of green light kept flying into the sky, and nearly a hundred patrolling eagle guards flew towards this side with harsh bird calls. The howls of wolves from far and near are even more continuous, and Chang'an seems to have turned into a den of wild wolves. There are howls of wolves everywhere, and there are green figures everywhere, galloping towards this direction with the strong wind.
Just a cup of tea, nearly a hundred patrolling eagle guards gathered in the sky and circled rapidly. The phantom of the strange green bird stirred up the strong wind, causing the raindrops to shoot downward like bullets. More than three hundred Xunwu from the Patrol Division who had merged with the Broken Wind Green Wolf beast soul also rushed to the scene. The surrounding walls were filled with people from the Patrol Division.
Then more than a dozen rough lion roars came from afar, and a dozen men wearing heavy armor, with blazing fire all over their bodies, and behind them a flaming male lion beast spirit ranging from four feet to eight feet in height. Tall, burly and unusually strong men rushed over with a large group of soldiers.
Everyone was staring at Ye Chong with strange eyes.
Among the last dozen or so strong men who arrived, the flaming lion beast soul behind him was eight feet high, and his whole body was emitting billowing heat. As soon as the raindrops approached him, they turned into water vapor and flew away. The strong man, whose body was wrapped in thick white water vapor, strode forward. With a height of one and a half feet taller than Ye Zhong, he looked down at Ye Zhong and looked him up and down for a long time.
"That boy Yan Yan's 'best friend'? Hey, fuck his eighteenth generation's 'best friend'? That boy Yan Yan is really lucky!"
Ye Chong grinned and smiled dryly. The aura exuding from this big man is really scary. It is strong, majestic, and extremely violent. This is a true master at the peak of the Martial Emperor. The power on his body is much stronger than that of Yao Chen, the King of Medicine.
After laughing a few times, Ye Chong raised his hands to the big man who looked to be in his thirties and said, "I don't know what the general's name is?"
The big man laughed strangely and slapped Ye Zhong hard on the shoulder: "My surname is Yan, Yan Yan. My name is Yan Hui, the Xifeng Guard Grand Patrol of the Han Dynasty Patrol Division, and I am Yan Yan's biological father. Did you just say that you wanted to fuck his eighteenth generation ancestor?"
The Wind Patrol Division of the Han Dynasty was divided into five major wind guards: southeast, northwest, middle, and southeast. They respectively corresponded to many vassal states in the four directions of the Han Dynasty, southeast, northwest, and the affairs of the Han Dynasty itself. Daxun Shou is the highest executive officer of Fengwei. He has the right to kill first and then report. In many cases, even if he kills first but not report, no one will investigate the details.
At this moment, cold sweat broke out on Zhu Yi's forehead. Xifengwei, the Patrol Division, was responsible for monitoring the many vassal states in the west of the Han Dynasty. The Song Dynasty was one of the vassal states in the west of the Han Dynasty. In a sense, the West Wind Guard is a sharp knife hanging over the heads of many wealthy families in the Song Dynasty.
Although the Han Dynasty never interfered easily in the internal affairs of the vassal states, who would dare to say no if the majestic Xifeng Guard really wanted to interfere in the affairs of the Song Dynasty? Who would say no? If Yan Hui said that he wanted to rectify the Song Dynasty, I don't know how many people would jump up and lift rocks and throw them on the head of the Song Dynasty.
With a dry cough, Zhu Yi took two steps forward, saluted Yan Hui and said, "This is a great hunting expedition. Zhu Yi is polite here."
Yan Hui chuckled a few times, waved his hand towards Zhu Yi, and laughed loudly: "Stop talking nonsense, so many people have heard what this kid said just now. And I, Yan Hui, am a well-established and respectable person in Chang'an. If I am insulted by this kid in person, how can I meet people if I am called Yan Hui in the future?"
He glared at Ye Zhong who was as if nothing had happened. He smacked his lips, looked at Zhu Yi and sneered, "Who are you? What happened tonight? Hey, a section of the black armored wall of the city fell down for more than three miles. Who has such a big blood feud with you and wants to kill you?".
Stretching out his hand, Yan Hui grabbed Zhu Yi's neck, and then laughed and said: "Hey, what are you talking nonsense to you little babies? Take him back and torture him, don't you know anything? Children, we have arrested someone, prepare someone to let them enjoy!".
Ye Zhong stopped in front of Zhu Yi, stretched out his hand and struck at Yan Hui's wrist vein. Ye Zhong then said calmly: "Why should the Grand Patrol be angry? You guys are rude, and you are forced to have no choice. If you don't scream like this, the lives of these guys may not be saved.".
Seeing that Ye Zhong actually dared to attack him, Yan Hui's eyes flashed with fire and he burst into laughter. He closed his palm and turned into a fist, punching Ye Zhong's palm, and then laughed and said: "Okay, come on, come on, come on, if you can beat me, I will take care of everything tonight for you!".
When their fists and palms collided, Ye Zhong felt like a huge mountain was pressing down on him. The force shook him so much that he lost his footing. He grunted and stepped back. The fiery punch blasted into the meridians of Ye Zhong's arm, but it just happened to neutralize the cold and cold air that the demon invaded his meridians just now. Water and fire were in conflict, and the hot and cold air quickly neutralized. The vitality in Ye Zhong's meridians fluctuated, and his arm, which was a little stiff and inflexible just now, suddenly returned to normal.
Yan Hui was shaken, and he punched Ye Zhong's palm. Although he was able to repel Ye Zhong, he was also twisted by the strange vortex-like energy in Ye Zhong's palm, and 80% of his punch was in vain. His body trembled, and the punch he punched into the air pulled his body forward, staggering a dozen steps towards the diagonal stab, and punched a hole in the wall on the side of the road.
"What a punch!" Ye Zhong shouted.
"Good palm power!" Yan Hui retracted his fist in surprise and looked at Ye Zhong fiercely, "You are actually in the realm of King Wu at such a young age. Huh? That boy just called himself Zhu Yi? Could it be Zhu Yi? Could it be that you, boy, are his disciple Ye Zhong?"
Zhu Yi was overjoyed, and he hurriedly responded: "Have you heard of Zhu Yi's name, too?"
"Bah!" Yan Hui spit out thick phlegm on the ground. He slapped his forehead heavily and shouted, "That boy Yan Yan has talked about you. If you are not waiting for the reward in the Song Dynasty, why are you coming to Chang'an?".
A gentle wolf howl came, and Yan Yan led several people and rushed over from a distance. A green shadow flashed past, and Yan Yan jumped down onto the street. After taking a look at Ye Chong, he said with great joy: "It's you indeed! Ye Chong, your mouth is really hard to tolerate!".
Shaking his head, Yan Yan looked at Yan Hui and reported: "Dachun Shou, Zhu Yi may be a descendant of Zuo Guozheng. He should have gone to the Guozong Mansion to identify the bloodline inheritance, return to the clan, and inherit Zuo Guozheng's title and Zuo Guozheng's official position."
Smiling at Zhu Yi, Yan Yan then said in a deep voice: "I just received the news that Lord Guozong Liu Gegong is coming here with Mrs. Rongyang.".
